Channel-creation option ordering/line endings were normalized before this freeze; the route fixtures create channels through the real API and join through production room controls.

limitations: Four-person preview mesh only; larger SFU rooms, group camera/share, simultaneous shares and computer audio remain open
Read and send are required together; separate connect/speak/listen/track-publication permissions remain open
General MLS membership/governance epoch changes stop capture and may require everyone to rejoin; seamless general channel rekey and device switching remain open
Occupancy and public P-256 contributions are visible to the host; signed public statements provide no private media key
Host controls availability and may withhold occupancy/departure. Valid active leases persist until expiry; local leave is immediate, remote disappearance has bounded lease/verification latency
Rebuilding peer links may cause brief audio gaps; no seamless physical-network claim
Five real test identities in one runtime with generated tracks and test autoplay; physical permissions, speakers/microphones and independent networks unvalidated
TURN is loopback Docker; TCP describes client-to-relay transport, not TURN-TLS or all-TCP media routing
macOS/Linux, external SFrame interoperability, measured audience/load limits and independent security review remain separate gates
Selected endpoints can record/disclose content; JavaScript/WebCrypto disposal is not guaranteed secure erasure
